sermon.title: Testimony Time - November 26, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla (host) with church members
sermon.summary: A Thanksgiving service of worship and sharing. Psalm 92 reminds us it is good to give thanks; Mrs. Thompson teaches how and why to praise, which pleases God more than sacrifices; Mrs. Gomez tells how she grew by staying in church and later shared Christmas and Thanksgiving with foster children; and a member shares that God is doing a new thing.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Multiple speakers. Worship and a special song (“My Jesus”) run to about 29:24. Psalm 22:3 is cited as “Psalms 223,” Psalm 24:8 as “Psalms 248.”

faqs.question: Do we have to wither when we’re old?
faqs.answer: No; he wants purpose and life still flowing, bearing fruit when older.

faqs.question: What does it mean to bless the Lord?
faqs.answer: To speak well of Him or say good things about Him.

faqs.question: Who wrote Hebrews?
faqs.answer: Mrs. Thompson says the writer is probably the apostle Paul.

faqs.question: What does magnify mean?
faqs.answer: To make it bigger, like a magnifying glass you need when you’re old.

faqs.question: Does praise please God more than tithes?
faqs.answer: She says it pleases God more than our tithes and offerings and our helping out.

faqs.question: Who did Mrs. Gomez see that morning?
faqs.answer: Kids from school she hadn’t seen in a long time.

faqs.question: What children did she ask for?
faqs.answer: Domestics, kids who live here, but she was given others.

faqs.answer: Playing with them; she also makes waffles on Saturdays.

faqs.question: What were Mrs. Gomez’s parties like?
faqs.answer: She went all out for sleepovers and birthday parties.
